author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Kanji Sizzle Trailer for Persona 4 Revival, a remake of the hit turn-based RPG developed by Atlus. Make way for the legendary delinquent - Kanji Tatsumi in Persona 4 Revival, launching on February 18, 2027, for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Game Pass, and PC (Steam).
title: Persona 4 Revival - Official Kanji Sizzle Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Etheria: Restart SS6 Season trailer for this turn-based strategy RPG. In addition to four new playable Animuses, this brand-new season also introduces new PVE and PVP modes, new character outfits, new main story chapters, and a special celebration event to mark the first anniversary of Etheria: Restart’s global launch. Etheria: Restart SS6 Season is available now on PC and mobile.
title: Etheria: Restart - Official SS6 Season Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at the release date trailer for Driving Test Simulator, a driving sim developed by 
aitchGames. Driving Test Simulator challenges your precision, control, and consistency through a series of increasingly difficult driving tests. Drive in changing conditions, including drizzle, storms, and night driving — each of which affects visibility and control. Driving Test Simulator will launch on September 16 on PC (Steam).
title: Driving Test Simulator - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a closer look at the Hammer Boosted Action in this latest Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance trailer for the upcoming action RPG expansion. The new trailer spotlights the Hammer and breaks down its Boosted Action, featuring aerial assaults, erupting movements, and bigger bonks. Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance takes the hunt to new heights in Master Rank. New monsters and challenges, evolved hunting actions and mechanics, a new locale, and the next chapter in the Expedition Team's story await in Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance, available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and PC in 2027.
title: Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance - Official Hammer Boosted Action Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the launch trailer for Donutal, a sci-fi adventure game developed by Arc System Works. Players will find themselves as the Chief Xeno Inspector at a spaceport. Converse with other aliens who are on Earth to understand their true motivations for visiting the planet before it's destroyed. Donutal is available now on PC (Steam).
title: Donutal - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Mercedes-Benz Trucks Dual Pack 2 Trailer for SnowRunner, an off-road simulation game developed by Saber Interactive. Players can gain access to two new vehicles, with the Mercedes-Benz NG3850 and the LG1519 6x6 “Mamute” ready to take on any environment that lies ahead. The Mercedes-Benz Trucks Dual Pack 2 is available now for SnowRunner on PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam).
title: SnowRunner - Official Mercedes-Benz Trucks Dual Pack 2 Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Release Date Trailer for Seafarer: The Ship Sim, a ship management game developed by Astragon Development. Players will run the day-to-day operations of a bustling port to manage ship imports, unforeseen situations, and ensure safety at all costs. Seafarer: The Ship Sim is launching on September 24 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Seafarer: The Ship Sim - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Gameplay Trailer for Wardens of Avalon, a hack-and-slash action RPG developed by Runes Studio. Players will fight across a world touched by oblivion as a Twilight Knight. Craft items, upgrade gear, and claim your place at the Round Table. Wardens of Avalon is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Wardens of Avalon - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Building Materials Overview Trailer for Restitched, an upcoming platformer developed by Trixel Creative. Players can get the rundown on the variety of building materials to use in custom levels, including tile, wood, stone, and more. Restitched is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Restitched - Official Building Materials Overview Trailer
